_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Emilie Poulsson (1853-1939): Dikken Zwilgmeyer's What Happened to Inger Johanne (1919), Johnny Blossom (1912) and Inger Johanne's Lively Doings (1920). Her Top-of-the-World Stories is already held elsewhere. Her Top-of-the-World Stories (with Laura E. Poulsson) is on Lane D's poulsson_shelf.json; this shelf holds the Zwilgmeyer books and could merge into that one. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 37); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
